title: 01 / Open the heist. Meet your candy guardian.
detail: The actual Caspy interface · illustrated example, no live game

title: 02 / Write a reason that belongs in Caspy’s world.
detail: Type your story, trade or heartfelt pitch. Up to 500 characters.

title: 03 / Send your prompt with Enter or the orange arrow.
detail: Wait for Caspy’s reply, then adapt your next reason. Three prompts maximum.

title: Confirmed win / Your score is saved before the artwork.
detail: Example grade A · 84/100. This fictional score is not a guaranteed outcome.

title: Your choice / Approve artwork, then generate your candy.
detail: Read the generation notice and confirm you have rights to use the prompt.

title: Creating / FLUX turns your winning words into candy artwork.
detail: Time is condensed here. Local generation can take several minutes.

title: Ready / Inspect your candy, then choose Mint my candy.
detail: The finished image keeps the saved grade. Minting uses local test ETH.

title: Confirmed / Your candy becomes a collectible NFT.
detail: After confirmation, open Collection. This is a staged tutorial, not a real mint.
